## FAQ
Q1. What is PromptGen Pro?
A1. PromptGen Pro generates production-ready AI prompts with variables, examples, and guardrails.
Q2. What do I describe?
A2. The task you want the model to perform.
Q3. Which models does it target?
A3. Prompts suitable for ChatGPT, Claude, and API-style calls.
Q4. Does it include variables?
A4. Yes. Variable placeholders make prompts reusable.
Q5. Who should use it?
A5. Teams that want structured prompts instead of ad-hoc chat paste.
Q6. Does it replace evaluation?
A6. No. It drafts prompts; you still judge outputs for your use case.
